澀.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 歰 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "unsmooth". The meaning later shifted to "rough" and "astringent".

兀.o: Depicts a person with the head emphasized, conveying the meaning "stand tall".
w: lofty or towering; sudden or abrupt
x: 我想问你一个问题，不晓得会不会很突兀。
Wǒ xiǎng wèn nǐ yī ge wèntí, bù xiǎodé huì bù huì hěn tūwù.
I'd like to ask you something. I don't know if it might be too out of the blue.
这里的山路很陡峭，到处都是突兀的岩石。
Zhèlǐ de shānlù hěn dǒuqiào, dàochù dōu shì tūwù de yánshí.
The mountain road here is very steep. There are towering rocks all around.

瘀.o: Phonosemantic compound. 疒 represents the meaning and 於 represents the sound.
x: 因重击造成的深蓝色或深紫色瘀伤。
Yīn zhòngjī zàochéng de shēn lánsè huò shēn zǐsè yūshāng.
Dark blue or purple bruises caused by a hard hit

c.h: Shorthand for the 禾 component in the traditional character 稟.

禀.o: Simplified form of 稟. Depicts a granary (㐭) for storing grains (禾) in. 㐭 also represents the sound. Similar in origin to 嗇. Based on the original meaning "grain storage facility". The meaning later shifted to "to endow" and "report to".
w: to report back to one's superior

犀.o: Phonosemantic compound. 尾 represents the sound and 牛 represents the meaning.
w: rhinoceros horn, reputed to confer telepathic powers
x: 他在信中的用词非常犀利。
Tā zài xìn zhōng de yòngcí fēicháng xīlì.
His wording in the letter is very sharp.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.
Depicts a person (大) with their hands and feet tied up.

缀.o: Simplified form of 綴. Phonosemantic compound. 纟 represents the meaning and 叕 represents the sound. Originally written as 叕, which depicted a person with their hands and feet tied up.
w: prefix or suffix of a compound word
to hesitate; to have second thoughts
x: 你们嘀咕什么呢？也告诉我听听？
Nǐmen dígu shénme ne? Yě gàosu wǒ tīngting?
What are you people muttering about? How about telling me as well?
这事儿行不行啊？我心里直犯嘀咕。
Zhèi shìr xíng bù xíng a? Wǒ xīnlǐ zhí fàn dígu.
Will this thing work out? My heart keeps on being dubious and uneasy.

桀.o: Depicts two feet (舛) on top of a tree (木). Based on the original meaning, "to be elevated", now written as 傑. The current meaning "cruel" is a phoentic loan.

帀.o: Origin unclear. Possibly depicts the roots of a plant.

馀.o: Phonosemantic compound. 饣 represents the meaning and 余 represents the sound.

畀.o: Originally a pictograph of an arrow with a large arrowhead. Unrelated to the current meaning "give", which is a phonetic loan.

髀.o: A low 卑 bone 骨; 卑 also provides the pronunciation

an old, tired horse, a jade; tired, exhausted

叀.o: Pictograph of a spinning wheel or spindle.

肀.o: Variant of 聿. Pictograph of a hand holding a writing utensil.

覀.o: 覀 is a character component that does not have any meaning on its own and can have different explanations in different characters. For example, it represents two hands grabbing a waist in the character 要.
